scope: Four fresh core crash/recovery cases plus three minimum-count healthy diagnostic trials on one retained Compose lab; each reconciles all earlier acknowledged histories. Original failures remain failed.
limits: Not sustained capacity, a cross-system/language ranking, or a controlled cold-cache benchmark.
New processor process/topic per trial, but shared retained brokers/caches and growing historical replay work; no 60-second discarded warmup or five-minute steady-state measurement.
Both customers and readers have caches/buffers. CDC probe versions change continuously; customer display fields are held fixed during measured orders. No temporal join/linearizability claim.
Cgroup CPU includes native CLI inspection and historical verifier work; input/pipeline windows are separate. Docker VM/daemon overhead excluded.
Memory maxima are sampled individual-container charged/anonymous memory. Host peak RSS is process-lifetime, not per-trial or whole-stack peak.
Docker API exposes block bytes but not IOPS/IO latency/queue depth here; those were not collected, not assumed zero.
Data creation timestamps have millisecond resolution; callback/latency reporting precision does not establish clock accuracy.
Extended disk/partition/quorum/scaling/upgrade/pressure/restore and fair workload matrices remain unrun.
Bulky journals/log copies are removed only after publication; retained summaries/hashes cannot replay deleted raw events.

native_compression.method: Copied all six source and enriched partition log segments from one fully repaired replica after trials. Verified every magic-2 batch CRC32C; decoded record sections with maintained LZ4 bindings. Ratio excludes 61-byte batch headers, indexes, RF3 overhead and WAL/metadata. Physical data includes aborted transactions; control batches counted separately. This is not a separate compression-CPU benchmark.

host.placement: One Docker Desktop VM on a shared host; no independent host/AZ durability or isolated-host capacity claim.

known_negative_control.scope: Original one-record stale-CDC failure retained separately; excluded from the passing cohort. Fingerprints checked by every completed experiment.

trial_summary.method: Median/min/max of three trial rates; IQR uses inclusive linear interpolation. Sequential retained-broker diagnostics, not independent cold-process capacity trials.
